items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] We'll be talking about Nancy in the back...

ctx.x: Yeah, we'll go into something else. I know a plain old thing, but I knew somebody was way back, I can't remember.
We'll be talking about Nancy in the back, but maybe I want to see something here. All right. Wait a minute. Okay. Can I make that? Oh, let's turn it a minute. Oh.

Yeah, we were looking over that list of tunes there on the ledger. We're going to have to copy that someday. Yeah, yeah, copy that. Yeah, and we mentioned Coconut Island. Yeah, oh yeah. On a Coconut Island. It was good. Tell us about that, Billy, when you used to play it.
